articles.title: Kerala Blasters' takeover and Inter Kashi's wage row show money pressures on ISL teams
articles.summary: Two early developments in the 2026-27 Indian Super League (ISL) season have put the spotlight on the financial realities facing clubs under the league’s new club-run structure. One of the ISL’s most followed sides is set for a change of ownership, while a former head coach has publicly questioned unpaid wages at another club.

articles.title: IBM India Chief Praises India’s Balanced Approach to AI Regulation and Innovation

articles.title: Ind AS 118: India Inc gears up for big changes to financial reporting
articles.summary: Indias largest companies are preparing for the implementation of Ind AS 118, which may impact financial reporting. Changes include new classifications for income and expenses, and new operating profit reporting methods. Companies face challenges due to complex requirements and the need for system adjustments. Audit committees are discussing transition plans while awaiting final rules and guidance from regulatory bodies.

articles.title: Indian victim compensation scheme faces severe delays and payout gaps
articles.summary: A new study reveals that India's victim compensation scheme is struggling with rising backlogs and procedural delays, leaving pending cases at 33,257 during the 2023 to 2024 period. The research highlights significant state-wise payout gaps across the country. These administrative bottlenecks hinder justice for victims, prompting concerns about the efficiency of the current support framework moving forward.
articles.title_hi: भारतीय पीड़ित मुआवजा योजना को गंभीर देरी और भुगतान अंतराल का सामना करना पड़ता है

articles.title: Indian law firms ramp up hiring for top litigation and dispute partners
articles.summary: Indian law firms are increasing the recruitment of litigation partners to handle rising commercial and corporate disputes. Large firms, midsize practices, and boutiques are seeing higher demand due to cross-border legal challenges and foreign investor expectations. Companies face complex regulatory matters and investigations across multiple international jurisdictions, driving the urgent need for experienced legal professionals.

articles.title: Rahul to launch Punjab Cong poll campaign from Sangrur on Nov 4
articles.summary: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi is set to visit Sangrur on Nov 4 to launch the party’s poll campaign for the 2027 Punjab assembly elections, state Congress chief Pargat Singh announced on Sunday. articles.title: Mumbai Hashish Seizure: Crime Branch Arrests Man in Bandra

articles.title: Indian opposition and youth protests challenge government over electoral rolls
articles.summary: Thousands of protesters and opposition parties have taken to the streets in India to oppose controversial voter roll revisions and demand the election chief resignation. The demonstrations, gaining momentum since October, challenge the ruling establishment over citizens rights and the fairness of the electoral process, aiming to pressure the government and protect democratic norms.

articles.title: India Expands Infrastructure And Manufacturing Scale Under Prime Minister Modi

Capital expenditure grew more than fivefold to support transport, electronics, defence, and space industries. This strategic investment aims to reduce foreign dependency, boost domestic production, and drive long-term economic growth across the country.

articles.title: Prime Minister Modi Marks Twenty-Five Years in Government amid Infrastructure Growth

articles.title: 95 drug samples manufactured in HP fail quality tests
articles.summary: Across the country, 331 drug samples were found to be substandard, with Uttarakhand reporting 69 failures, followed by Maharashtra with 23, Madhya Pradesh with 22 and Haryana with 21. Rajasthan reported 17 failures, while Gujarat and Tamil Nadu reported 15 each and Punjab 13. The findings have brought the quality of medicines manufactured in Himachal Pradesh under scrutiny.
articles.title_hi: हिमाचल प्रदेश में निर्मित 95 दवाओं के नमूने गुणवत्ता परीक्षण में विफल रहे
articles.summary_hi: देश भर में, 331 दवाओं के नमूने घटिया पाए गए, जिनमें से उत्तराखंड में 69 विफलताएं दर्ज की गईं, इसके बाद महाराष्ट्र में 23, मध्य प्रदेश में 22 और हरियाणा में 21 विफलताएं दर्ज की गईं। राजस्थान में 17 विफलताएं दर्ज की गईं, जबकि गुजरात और तमिलनाडु में 15-15 और पंजाब में 13 विफलताएं दर्ज की गईं। निष्कर्षों ने हिमाचल प्रदेश में निर्मित दवाओं की गुणवत्ता को जांच के दायरे में ला दिया है।
articles.title_hinglish: himachala pradesha men nirmita 95 davaon ke namune gunavatta parikshana men viphala rahe
articles.summary_hinglish: desha bhara men, 331 davaon ke namune ghatiya pae gae, jinamen se uttarakhanda men 69 viphalataen darja ki gaeen, isake bada maharashtra men 23, madhya pradesha men 22 aura hariyana men 21 viphalataen darja ki gaeen। rajasthana men 17 viphalataen darja ki gaeen, jabaki gujarata aura tamilanadu men 15-15 aura panjaba men 13 viphalataen darja ki gaeen। nishkarshon ne himachala pradesha men nirmita davaon ki gunavatta ko jancha ke dayare men la diya hai।

articles.title: Karnataka's DK Shivakumar warns IT firms of action over alleged bias against Kannadigas
articles.summary: Chief Minister DK Shivakumar expressed concern over job discrimination against Kannadigas in technology companies. He highlighted the seriousness of complaints regarding biased recruitment practices in Bengaluru. His statements came after a viral video showcasing the issue and prompted a wider online discussion. The government intends to take appropriate action against firms found to be discriminating against local candidates.
articles.title_hi: कर्नाटक के डीके शिवकुमार ने कन्नडिगाओं के खिलाफ कथित पूर्वाग्रह पर आईटी कंपनियों को कार्रवाई की चेतावनी दी

articles.title: IndiGo, Air India Express to shift Mumbai flights to Navi Mumbai airport
articles.summary: India’s two biggest airline groups are preparing to move more flights to Navi Mumbai International Airport, a shift that will free up capacity at Mumbai’s existing airport as it prepares for a major terminal redevelopment. IndiGo will begin international operations from Navi Mumbai in February 2027, transferring 12 daily departures from Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport, Adani Airports said Sunday.

articles.title: Eminent Indian Painter And Former Politician Jogen Chowdhury Dies At 87
articles.summary: Renowned painter and former parliamentarian Jogen Chowdhury passed away on Sunday at the age of 87 after battling a rare blood cancer. Born in what is now Bangladesh, he was celebrated for his distinctive use of unbroken lines in contemporary art. He also served as a professor at Visva Bharati University and represented his party in Parliament.

articles.title: Market recap: Eight of top 10 firms lose Rs 1.55 lakh crore; HDFC Bank
articles.summary: The combined market valuation of eight of India’s top 10 most valuable companies declined by Rs 1. 55 lakh crore last week, with HDFC Bank and Bajaj Finance emerging as the biggest losers. articles.title: Oath-Taking Ceremony of New Jammu Kashmir Ministers Likely on Tuesday
articles.summary: Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha will administer the oath of office and secrecy to the newly inducted ministers. “The existing ministers who have been retained by the Chief Minister will not be required to take the oath again. Only the new faces inducted into the Council of Ministers will be administered the oath,” the source said.

articles.title: Over One Hundred Detained in Delhi During Election Commission Protest
articles.summary: More than one hundred people were detained in New Delhi during a protest demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over electoral roll revisions. Demonstrators raised concerns about new declaration requirements in registration forms. The Supreme Court is examining challenges involving the Election Commission, while opposition leaders and student activists have joined the wider political confrontation.

articles.title_hinglish: chunava aayoga ke virodha ke daurana dilli men eka sau se adhika loga hirasata men liye gaye

articles.title: Bangladesh Government Ensures Safe Hindu Festival Amid Tight Security
articles.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman deployed thousands of security personnel across Bangladesh to safeguard the annual Hindu festival of Durga Puja. Authorities extended official holidays and increased financial assistance to committees, ensuring celebrations remained peaceful. This heavy deployment aimed to protect the minority community following years of anxiety and past violence, though community leaders continue demanding long-term justice.

articles.title: Toyota Plans Small Hybrid Cars to Drive Growth in India
articles.summary: Toyota plans to offer hybrid powertrain to smaller cars Aims to offer ADAS with more models New Maharashtra facility to add another 1 lakh annual capacity A new media report claims that Toyota is evaluating its hybrid powertrain technology for the smaller car segments in India. The company aims to make its strong hybrid tech more accessible to mass-market buyers.

articles.title: Foot overbridge near JIPMER finds few takers in Puducherry

articles.title: 'Mann Ki Baat' has become world's most popular programme: BJP chief Nitin Nabin

articles.title: Investments in emerging sectors rise, but bank and NBFC financing remain limited: Report
articles.summary: New Delhi [India], October 25 (ANI): Despite rising investments across emerging sectors like AI and space technology, bank and non-banking financial company (NBFC) lending remains limited, as per a report by Union Bank of India.   Advertisement According to the report, emerging sectors such as AI, semiconductors, defence and green hydrogen are attracting massive investments.

articles.title: Meghalaya CM thanks PM Modi for recognising state’s ‘rich tradition of millet cultivation’
articles.summary: Modi spoke about Meghalaya's millet-growing traditions and efforts to revive cultivation and promote millet-based products, drawing attention to initiatives in the state's West Garo Hills and West Jaintia Hills districts. articles.title: Navi Mumbai airport adds nine domestic destinations to expand regional connectivity
articles.summary: Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIA) has added nine domestic destinations to its network, connecting the Mumbai Metropolitan Region with markets across Rajasthan, Bihar, Assam, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Lakshadweep and coastal Maharashtra. The expansion aims to improve regional access, support tourism and strengthen links with heritage, wildlife, island and eco-tourism destinations.
articles.title_hi: नवी मुंबई हवाई अड्डा क्षेत्रीय कनेक्टिविटी का विस्तार करने के लिए नौ घरेलू गंतव्य जोड़ता है
articles.summary_hi: नवी मुंबई अंतर्राष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डे (NMIA) ने अपने नेटवर्क में नौ घरेलू गंतव्य जोड़े हैं, जो मुंबई महानगर क्षेत्र को राजस्थान, बिहार, असम, झारखंड, पश्चिम बंगाल, लक्षद्वीप और तटीय महाराष्ट्र के बाजारों से जोड़ते हैं। विस्तार का उद्देश्य क्षेत्रीय पहुंच में सुधार करना, पर्यटन का समर्थन करना और विरासत, वन्य जीवन, द्वीप और पर्यावरण-पर्यटन स्थलों के साथ संबंधों को मजबूत करना है।
articles.title_hinglish: navi munbaee havaee adda kshetriya kanektiviti ka vistara karane ke lie nau gharelu gantavya jodata hai
articles.summary_hinglish: navi munbaee antarrashtriya havaee adde (NMIA) ne apane netavarka men nau gharelu gantavya jodaे hain, jo munbaee mahanagara kshetra ko rajasthan, bihar, asam, jharakhand, pashchima bangal, lakshadvipa aura tatiya maharashtra ke bajaron se jodate hain। vistara ka uddeshya kshetriya pahuncha men sudhara karan, paryatana ka samarthana karana aura virasat, vanya jivan, dvipa aura paryavarana-paryatana sthalon ke satha sanbandhon ko majabuta karana hai।

articles.title: Indian Railways Launches First Salt Container Train In Gujarat
articles.summary: Indian Railways has launched a specialised salt container train between Shivlakha Gati Shakti Cargo Terminal in Kutch and Mithapur, Gujarat. Inaugurated on September 15, the service uses lightweight stainless-steel containers designed to protect salt from rain and moisture, improve loading capacity, streamline handling and reduce transportation costs for the salt industry.
